# Turfzo — Turf & Sports Venue Booking Platform
> Book football turfs, cricket grounds, badminton courts, and tennis venues across India with real-time slot availability and transparent per-hour pricing.

Canonical URL: https://turfzo.app

## Platform Facts
- Sports supported: Football, Cricket, Badminton, Tennis, Multipurpose venues.
- Booking pricing: Hourly rates set by each venue (INR/hr), plus a flat 5% platform service fee shown upfront before checkout.
- Cancellation policy: 100% slot refund 24+ hours before start, 50% slot refund 6-24 hours before start, non-refundable under 6 hours (platform service fee is retained).
- Venue owners: Free to list (₹0 monthly subscription); 95% owner payout / 5% platform commission on completed bookings, with 24-hour payout turnaround via UPI or bank transfer.
